mechanisms.label: Soluble lysosomal enzyme missing
mechanisms.description: The missing protein is an enzyme that floats inside the lysosome. Cells can take it up from outside (cross-correction), which is why enzyme replacement and gene therapy can also help neighbouring cells.
mechanisms.quote: These are soluble lysosomal enzymes that can be secreted and taken up by cells via mannose-6-phosphate receptors (MPRs) in a process named “cross-correction”

mechanisms.label: Membrane protein missing
mechanisms.description: The missing protein sits in a cell membrane, so it cannot pass from one cell to another. A therapy has to reach each cell.
mechanisms.quote: five encoding transmembrane proteins with various subcellular locations ( CLN3 , CLN6 , CLN7/MFSD8, CLN8 , and CLN12 / ATP13A2 )

mechanisms.label: Lysosomal membrane protein
mechanisms.description: The missing protein works in the membrane of the lysosome or the late endosome.
mechanisms.quote: CLN7 is located in lysosomes and endosomes and is considered as an endolysosomal chloride channel

mechanisms.label: Transport across the lysosomal membrane
mechanisms.description: The missing protein moves molecules or ions across the lysosomal membrane.
mechanisms.quote: CLN3 is required for the efflux of GPDs from the lysosome

mechanisms.label: Sending new lysosomal enzymes out of the ER
mechanisms.description: The missing protein sits in the endoplasmic reticulum and helps send newly made lysosomal enzymes on towards the lysosome.
mechanisms.quote: CLN6 and CLN8 are obligate partners for the recruitment of newly synthesized lysosomal enzymes at the ER

mechanisms.label: Removing palmitate from proteins
mechanisms.description: The enzyme cuts a fatty acid (palmitate) off proteins so the lysosome can break them down.
mechanisms.quote: In the lysosome, PPT1 cleaves the thioester linkage of the fatty acid palmitate‐to‐cysteine residues of palmitoylated proteins (constituents of ceroid), a crucial step for their degradation within lysosomes

mechanisms.label: Trimming small peptides
mechanisms.description: The enzyme trims three amino acids at a time off small proteins being broken down in the lysosome.
mechanisms.quote: The mature enzyme cleaves tripeptides from the amino terminus of small polypeptides undergoing degradation in the lysosomes.
